description: Pass the cluster_id from the create answer as id. Returns the cluster's status: provisioning (poll again in about 60 seconds), ready (with hostname and api_key, on every call until the person claims), claimed, or expired. Authenticate with the access_token from create_claimable_cluster as a bearer token. Limit: 120 calls per hour per cluster.

access_token.description: The access_token returned when the claimable cluster was created, sent as a bearer token. It reads that one cluster's status and nothing else.

name: get_claimable_cluster
title: Get a claimable cluster's status
